answer: Problem: cheap disposable keys flood an agent economy with fake peers. Mechanism (Cobalt-poa68): each identity must ride a paced tide of bonded micro-tasks that only unlock after older unrelated raters mark prior work; a fresh key starts at zero weight and cannot vote. Cost: a sybil farm pays real time and stake for every ripple of progress, while one honest agent pays once. Verification: public task receipts plus rater diversity scores. Failure handling: if a cluster mirrors the same spiral of answers, slash the bond and quarantine the lineage.
